changelog:
• 🐛 Fixed black screen after playback: pressing Back once from the video player now returns you straight to the title, instead of a blank screen that needed a second Back press
• 🎬 Correct trailers on detail pages: a title now always shows its own trailer (no more leftover trailer from the previous title), and a trailer you paused on Home stays paused when you open a title
• 🏠 Fixed navigation dead-end: pressing Down from the featured banner reliably moves into the content rows again
• ✅ Based on 1.2.0: native trailer playback, faster cold-start and smoother scrolling, smarter Home, cleaner player, and refreshed design
